'''Soul Torch''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] replaces its vanilla recipe with a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from 8 × [[Torch]] + <span class="explain" title="Soul Sand, Soul Soil">any soul fire base blocks</span>). See {{MCW|Soul Torch}} for everything else.
